    """
    One template, 2 slots, no gate. Slots run independently in parallel.

      Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY): buy when close crosses above its SMA (invest 40% of
               total portfolio value); sell (liquidate lot) when close crosses below SMA.
      Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): buy $20,000 of AAPL when AAPL has been red 3 consecutive
               days and at least $20,000 cash is available; sell (liquidate lot) when the
               14-day RSI is above 60.
    """

    SMA_PERIOD = 200
    RSI_PERIOD = 14

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        self.symbols = {}
        for t in self.tickers:
            eq = self.AddEquity(t, Resolution.Daily)
            self.symbols[t] = eq.Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # --- Indicators (always updated from data, never gated) ---
        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        # --- Market-state tracking ---
        self.prev_close = {}          # ticker -> yesterday's close
        self.red_streak = {}          # ticker -> consecutive red-day count
        for t in self.tickers:
            self.prev_close[t] = None
            self.red_streak[t] = 0

        # Previous-bar values needed for cross detection
        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma = None

        # --- Private lots (shares owned by each strategy) ---
        self.lot_a = 0
        self.lot_b = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(max(self.SMA_PERIOD, self.RSI_PERIOD) + 1, Resolution.Daily)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def OnData(self, data):
        # Require today's bar for EVERY subscribed ticker.
        closes = {}
        opens = {}
        for t in self.tickers:
            sym = self.symbols[t]
            if not data.ContainsKey(sym):
                return
            bar = data[sym]
            if bar is None:
                return
            closes[t] = bar.Close
            opens[t] = bar.Open

        # ---- Market-state updates (continuous, never gated) ----
        for t in self.tickers:
            pc = self.prev_close[t]
            if pc is None:
                self.red_streak[t] = 0
            elif closes[t] < pc:
                self.red_streak[t] += 1
            else:
                self.red_streak[t] = 0

        spy_close = closes["SPY"]
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
        rsi_val = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady else None

        prev_spy_close = self.prev_spy_close
        prev_spy_sma = self.prev_spy_sma

        # Roll state forward for the next bar before any early return.
        for t in self.tickers:
            self.prev_close[t] = closes[t]
        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_spy_sma = spy_sma

        # ---- Trading gate: full history required ----
        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return
        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return
        if prev_spy_close is None or prev_spy_sma is None:
            return

        # =========================== SLOT 1: Strategy A ===========================
        cross_above = (prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma) and (spy_close > spy_sma)
        cross_below = (prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma) and (spy_close < spy_sma)

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.lot_a > 0 and cross_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
            self.lot_a = 0
        elif self.lot_a == 0 and cross_above:
            target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40
            qty = int(target_value / spy_close)
            if qty > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, qty)
                self.lot_a = qty

        # =========================== SLOT 2: Strategy B ===========================
        if self.lot_b > 0 and rsi_val > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.lot_b)
            self.lot_b = 0
        elif self.lot_b == 0 and self.red_streak["AAPL"] >= 3:
            budget = 20000.0
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= budget:
                qty = int(budget / closes["AAPL"])
                if qty > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, qty)
                    self.lot_b = qty

        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        for ticker in self.TICKERS:
            equity = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily)
            equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Adjusted)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # Indicators (always updated from data, never gated).
        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        # Market-state bookkeeping.
        self.prev_close = {}          # symbol -> yesterday's close
        self.red_streak = {}          # symbol -> consecutive red-day count
        self.prev_spy_close = None    # SPY close on the previous evaluated bar
        self.prev_spy_sma = None      # SPY SMA on the previous evaluated bar

        # Private lots (shares owned by each strategy).
        self.lot_a = 0
        self.lot_b = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(max(self.SMA_PERIOD, self.RSI_PERIOD) + 1, Resolution.Daily)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {}
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            bar = data.Bars.get(symbol)
            if bar is None:
                # Today's bar is missing for a subscribed ticker: skip all rules.
                self._update_market_state(data)
                return
            bars[ticker] = bar

        # Market-state quantities computed before any rule evaluation.
        prev_spy_close = self.prev_spy_close
        prev_spy_sma = self.prev_spy_sma
        red_streak_aapl = self._red_streak_with(self.aapl, bars["AAPL"].Close)

        self._update_market_state(data)

        if self.IsWarmingUp:
            return
        if not (self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return
        if prev_spy_close is None or prev_spy_sma is None:
            return

        spy_close = bars["SPY"].Close
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        aapl_close = bars["AAPL"].Close

        # ---------------- Slot 1: Strategy A (SPY) ---------------- #
        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.lot_a > 0:
            crossed_below = prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma and spy_close < spy_sma
            if crossed_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
                self.lot_a = 0
        elif self.lot_a == 0:
            crossed_above = prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma and spy_close > spy_sma
            if crossed_above:
                target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
                shares = int(target_value / spy_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.lot_a = shares

        # ---------------- Slot 2: Strategy B (AAPL) ---------------- #
        if self.lot_b > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.lot_b)
                self.lot_b = 0
        elif self.lot_b == 0:
            if red_streak_aapl >= 3:
                budget = 20000.0
                if self.Portfolio.Cash >= budget:
                    shares = int(math.floor(budget / aapl_close))
                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.lot_b = shares

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #

    def _red_streak_with(self, symbol, close):
        """Consecutive red-day count for `symbol` including today's close."""
        prev = self.prev_close.get(symbol)
        if prev is None:
            return 0
        if close < prev:
            return self.red_streak.get(symbol, 0) + 1
        return 0

    def _update_market_state(self, data):
        """Market-state quantities are computed continuously from data."""
        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            bar = data.Bars.get(symbol)
            if bar is None:
                continue
            close = bar.Close
            prev = self.prev_close.get(symbol)
            if prev is None:
                self.red_streak[symbol] = 0
            elif close < prev:
                self.red_streak[symbol] = self.red_streak.get(symbol, 0) + 1
            else:
                self.red_streak[symbol] = 0
            self.prev_close[symbol] = close

        spy_bar = data.Bars.get(self.spy)
        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            self.prev_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.prev_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

from AlgorithmImports import *
import math


class TwoSlotParallelTemplateAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    """
    One template, 2 slots, no gate. Both slots run independently in parallel.

      Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY): buy when close crosses above its SMA (invest 40% of
               total portfolio value); sell when close crosses below its SMA (liquidate lot).
      Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): buy when AAPL is red 3 consecutive days ($20,000 if
               that much cash is available, else do nothing); sell when the 14-day RSI
               closes above 60 (liquidate lot).

    All rules are evaluated once per daily bar, after the close. If today's bar is
    missing for ANY subscribed ticker, all rule evaluation is skipped for that day.
    """

    TICKERS = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]

    SMA_PERIOD = 50
    RSI_PERIOD = 14

    RED_STREAK_REQUIRED = 3
    STRATEGY_A_ALLOCATION = 0.40
    STRATEGY_B_CASH = 20000.0

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.TICKERS:
            equity = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # --- Indicators (always updated from data; never paused by any rule) ---
        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, self.RSI_PERIOD, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        # --- Continuously maintained market state ---
        self.prev_close = {}        # symbol -> yesterday's close
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0    # consecutive red days for AAPL

        # Cross detection state for Strategy A (yesterday's close vs yesterday's SMA)
        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma = None

        # --- Private lots (shares owned by each strategy) ---
        self.lot_a = 0
        self.lot_b = 0

        self.SetWarmUp(max(self.SMA_PERIOD, self.RSI_PERIOD) + 1, Resolution.Daily)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def _all_bars_present(self, data):
        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            bar = data.Bars.get(symbol) if data.Bars is not None else None
            if bar is None:
                return False
        return True

    def _indicators_ready(self):
        return self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

    def _update_market_state(self, data):
        """Streaks / previous closes are computed from data continuously."""
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
        prev_aapl = self.prev_close.get(self.aapl)
        if prev_aapl is not None:
            if aapl_close < prev_aapl:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            self.prev_close[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol].Close

    def _buy_shares(self, symbol, quantity, tag):
        if quantity <= 0:
            return 0
        self.MarketOrder(symbol, quantity, tag=tag)
        return quantity

    def _sell_shares(self, symbol, quantity, tag):
        if quantity <= 0:
            return 0
        self.MarketOrder(symbol, -quantity, tag=tag)
        return quantity

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Main event
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def OnData(self, data):
        if not self._all_bars_present(data):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
        aapl_rsi = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value

        # Cross evaluation needs yesterday's values captured before this bar's update.
        prev_spy_close = self.prev_spy_close
        prev_spy_sma = self.prev_spy_sma
        red_streak_before_today = self.aapl_red_streak

        # Always refresh continuously-computed market state.
        self._update_market_state(data)
        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_spy_sma = spy_sma

        if self.IsWarmingUp or not self._indicators_ready():
            return
        if prev_spy_close is None or prev_spy_sma is None:
            return

        red_streak_today = self.aapl_red_streak
        _ = red_streak_before_today  # streak prior to today's bar (unused directly)

        crossed_above = prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma and spy_close > spy_sma
        crossed_below = prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma and spy_close < spy_sma

        # ----- Sells are evaluated before buys on every bar. -----

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A sell: SPY close crosses below its SMA -> liquidate lot.
        if self.lot_a > 0 and crossed_below:
            sold = self._sell_shares(self.spy, self.lot_a, "A: SPY close crossed below SMA")

            equity.SetDataNormalizationMode(DataNormalizationMode.Adjusted)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.Symbol

        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # --- Indicators (updated continuously from data, never gated) ---
        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, self.SMA_PERIOD, Resolution.Daily)

    def _bars_present(self, data):
        """True only if today's bar exists for EVERY subscribed ticker."""
        for ticker in self.tickers:

            if not data.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return False
            bar = data[symbol]
            if bar is None:
                return False

    def _place(self, symbol, quantity, tag):
        """Submit a market order for the given signed quantity."""
        if quantity != 0:
            self.MarketOrder(symbol, quantity, False, tag)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    # Main event handler
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
    def OnData(self, data):
        # Skip ALL rule evaluation on any day with a missing bar for any ticker.
        if not self._bars_present(data):

        aapl_bar = data[self.aapl]
        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
        aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        prev_aapl_close = self.prev_close.get("AAPL", None)

        rsi_ready = self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
        rsi_value = self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value if rsi_ready else None

            self.prev_spy_close = spy_close

        prev_spy_sma = self.prev_spy_sma
        prev_rsi = self.prev_aapl_rsi

    One template, two slots, no gate. Both slots run independently in parallel.

      Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY): close crosses above/below 100-day SMA.
      Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): 3 consecutive red days -> buy $20,000;
                                  14-day RSI above 60 -> liquidate.
    """

    TICKERS = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.TICKERS:
            equity = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # --- Indicators (always updated from data, never gated) ---
        self.sma100 = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.rsi14 = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        # --- Continuously maintained market state ---
        self.prev_close = {}        # symbol -> yesterday's close
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0    # consecutive red days for AAPL

        # Cross state for SPY close vs SMA100 (yesterday's relationship)
        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_sma100 = None

        # --- Private lots, one per strategy ---
        self.lot_a = 0              # Strategy A shares of SPY
        self.lot_b = 0              # Strategy B shares of AAPL

        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _all_bars_present(self, data):
        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            bar = data.Bars.get(symbol)
            if bar is None:
                return False
        return True

    def _indicators_ready(self):
        return self.sma100.IsReady and self.rsi14.IsReady

    def _update_market_state(self, data):
        """Update streaks / previous values. Runs every valid bar, always."""
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
        prev_aapl = self.prev_close.get(self.aapl)
        if prev_aapl is not None:
            if aapl_close < prev_aapl:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            self.prev_close[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol].Close

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Main event
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def OnData(self, data):
        # Skip the entire day if any subscribed ticker is missing today's bar.
        if not self._all_bars_present(data):
            return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
        sma_value = self.sma100.Current.Value

        # Cross evaluation uses yesterday's pair vs today's pair.
        crossed_above = (
            self.prev_spy_close is not None
            and self.prev_sma100 is not None
            and self.prev_spy_close <= self.prev_sma100
            and spy_close > sma_value
        )
        crossed_below = (
            self.prev_spy_close is not None
            and self.prev_sma100 is not None
            and self.prev_spy_close >= self.prev_sma100
            and spy_close < sma_value
        )

        # Red-streak state must be updated from data regardless of trading.
        self._update_market_state(data)

        red_3 = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
        rsi_above_60 = self.rsi14.Current.Value > 60

        # Roll cross state forward for tomorrow.
        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_sma100 = sma_value

        if self.IsWarmingUp or not self._indicators_ready():
            return

        # ---------------- Sells before buys ----------------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A sell
        if self.lot_a > 0 and crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
            self.lot_a = 0

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B sell
        if self.lot_b > 0 and rsi_above_60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.lot_b)
            self.lot_b = 0

        # ---------------- Buys ----------------

        # Slot 1 - Strategy A buy: 40% of total portfolio value in SPY
        if self.lot_a == 0 and crossed_above:
            target_value = self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40
            quantity = int(target_value / spy_close)
            if quantity > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                self.lot_a = quantity

        # Slot 2 - Strategy B buy: $20,000 of AAPL if that much cash is available
        if self.lot_b == 0 and red_3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                    self.lot_b = quantity

    """
    One template, 2 slots, no gate, running independently in parallel.

      Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY): buy on close crossing above the 100-day SMA
               (40% of total portfolio value), sell on close crossing below it.
      Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL): buy $20,000 after 3 consecutive red days
               (only if >= $20,000 cash), sell when the 14-day RSI is above 60.
    """

    TICKERS = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]

    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.TICKERS:
            equity = self.add_equity(ticker, Resolution.DAILY)
            equity.set_data_normalization_mode(DataNormalizationMode.ADJUSTED)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # ---- Indicators (always updated from data, never gated) ----
        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, 100, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY)

        # ---- Market state ----
        self.prev_close = {}            # symbol -> yesterday's close
        self.prev_spy_close = None      # SPY close of yesterday (for cross detection)
        self.prev_spy_sma = None        # SPY SMA value as of yesterday
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0        # consecutive red days for AAPL

        # ---- Private lots (one per strategy/slot) ----
        self.lot_a = 0                  # shares of SPY owned by Strategy A
        self.lot_b = 0                  # shares of AAPL owned by Strategy B

        self.set_warm_up(0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        # Today's bar must exist for EVERY subscribed ticker, otherwise skip
        # all rule evaluation for the day (market state is not updated either).
        bars = {}
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            bar = data.bars.get(symbol) if data.bars is not None else None
            if bar is None:
                return
            bars[ticker] = bar

        spy_close = bars["SPY"].close
        aapl_close = bars["AAPL"].close

        # ---- Update continuously-computed market state ----
        prev_aapl_close = self.prev_close.get(self.aapl)
        if prev_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # Snapshot of yesterday's cross inputs before overwriting them.
        prev_spy_close = self.prev_spy_close
        prev_spy_sma = self.prev_spy_sma

        spy_sma_ready = self.spy_sma.is_ready
        spy_sma_value = self.spy_sma.current.value if spy_sma_ready else None

        # Everything needed for the next bar's evaluation.
        for ticker, bar in bars.items():
            self.prev_close[self.symbols[ticker]] = bar.close
        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_spy_sma = spy_sma_value

        # ---- Warm-up gate: no trading until every rule input is formed ----
        if not spy_sma_ready or not self.aapl_rsi.is_ready:
            return
        if prev_spy_close is None or prev_spy_sma is None:
            return
        if prev_aapl_close is None:
            return

        # ==============================================================
        # SELLS BEFORE BUYS
        # ==============================================================

        # ---- Slot 1 / Strategy A: sell on cross below the 100-day SMA ----
        if self.lot_a > 0:
            crossed_below = (prev_spy_close >= prev_spy_sma) and (spy_close < spy_sma_value)
            if crossed_below:
                self.market_order(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
                self.lot_a = 0

        # ---- Slot 2 / Strategy B: sell when 14-day RSI is above 60 ----
        if self.lot_b > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
                self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.lot_b)
                self.lot_b = 0

        # ==============================================================
        # BUYS
        # ==============================================================

        # ---- Slot 1 / Strategy A: buy on cross above the 100-day SMA ----
        if self.lot_a == 0:
            crossed_above = (prev_spy_close <= prev_spy_sma) and (spy_close > spy_sma_value)
            if crossed_above and spy_close > 0:
                target_value = 0.40 * self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value
                quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.lot_a = quantity

        # ---- Slot 2 / Strategy B: buy $20,000 after 3 red days ----
        if self.lot_b == 0:
            if self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if self.portfolio.cash >= 20000 and aapl_close > 0:
                    quantity = int(math.floor(20000 / aapl_close))

                        self.market_order(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.lot_b = quantity

    TICKERS = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.symbols = {}
        for ticker in self.TICKERS:
            equity = self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily)
            self.symbols[ticker] = equity.Symbol

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        # --- Indicators (manually updated from daily closes) ---
        self.sma100 = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.rsi14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        # --- Cross-detection state for Strategy A ---
        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_sma100 = None

        # --- Red-streak state for Strategy B ---
        self.prev_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # --- Private lots (shares owned by each strategy) ---
        self.lot_a = 0
        self.lot_b = 0

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def OnData(self, data):
        # Require today's bar for EVERY subscribed ticker; otherwise skip the day entirely.
        bars = {}
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return
            bar = data[symbol]
            if bar is None:
                return
            bars[ticker] = bar

        spy_close = bars["SPY"].Close
        aapl_close = bars["AAPL"].Close

        # --- Update market-state quantities (always, regardless of any gating) ---
        self.sma100.Update(self.Time, spy_close)
        self.rsi14.Update(self.Time, aapl_close)

        if self.prev_aapl_close is not None:
            if aapl_close < self.prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        sma_val = self.sma100.Current.Value if self.sma100.IsReady else None
        prev_spy_close = self.prev_spy_close
        prev_sma = self.prev_sma100

        # Roll previous-day state forward before any early exit.
        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_aapl_close = aapl_close
        self.prev_sma100 = sma_val

        # Do not trade until every indicator / rolling window is fully formed.
        if not self.sma100.IsReady or not self.rsi14.IsReady:
            return
        if prev_spy_close is None or prev_sma is None:
            return

        # ==============================================================
        # Slot 1 - Strategy A (SPY)
        # ==============================================================
        crossed_above = prev_spy_close <= prev_sma and spy_close > sma_val
        crossed_below = prev_spy_close >= prev_sma and spy_close < sma_val

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.lot_a > 0 and crossed_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.lot_a)
            self.lot_a = 0
        elif self.lot_a == 0 and crossed_above:
            target_value = 0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue
            shares = int(target_value / spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.lot_a = shares

        # ==============================================================
        # Slot 2 - Strategy B (AAPL)
        # ==============================================================
        if self.lot_b > 0 and self.rsi14.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.lot_b)
            self.lot_b = 0
        elif self.lot_b == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            budget = 20000.0
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= budget:
                shares = int(budget / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.lot_b = shares
